A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same VCU-Bridge research work and complete 39-page documents, including Appendices A–G. Text, equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison; pages 2–39 also render identically.

before.justification: v1 reports original model and human evaluations on HVCU-Bench, instruction-tuning experiments, ablations, and general-benchmark results in Section 4 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including HVCU-Bench evaluations, instruction-tuning experiments, ablations, and the additional results in Appendix D.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same three-level framework, benchmark generation and validation procedure, MCTS search, and instruction-data selection. The implementation and prompts are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training data, HVCU-Bench task families and fifteen aspects, and external evaluations on MMBench, HallusionBench, MMStar, and MMMU. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The model and human comparator sets in Tables 2–3 are identical. Appendix D also retains the same larger-model comparisons and Qwen3-VL-4B-Direct baseline.

E3.justification: The base/context evaluation settings, per-level and full-chain metrics, sample sizes, human-evaluation design, and training configurations remain identical in Sections 3–4 and Appendices B–D.

E4.justification: Both retain the hierarchical-context analysis, training-data composition ablation in Table 4, case study in Figure 5, and architecture and data-generation analyses in Appendix D. No analysis is added or revised.

E5.justification: Both report averaging human scores over three students per level. Neither adds repeated-run or seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Numerical results, rankings, plots, and qualitative findings are identical throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Figure 4 retains HVCU-Bench scores of 41.24 for Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct and 47.41 for Qwen3-VL-4B-Bridge.

T1.justification: Section 3 retains identical hierarchy definitions, pairwise support constraints, accuracy definitions, UCB formula, and reward-update equations. No mathematical reasoning or proof is added or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning semantic bridging, HVCU-Bench, MCTS-based data generation, and empirical gains.

C2.justification: The explanations of semantic-bridging bottlenecks and cross-task transfer are unchanged. Appendix E retains the same limitations concerning the discrete hierarchy, task coverage, and cultural subjectivity.

D1.justification: Appendix C preserves the same generation parameters, LoRA configuration, hardware, training time, and evaluation instructions. Appendix G prompts and the project-page link are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix A, and the references contain the same cited works and research positioning. No prior-work comparison or novelty relationship changes.

P1.justification: The first-page author line changes Arctanx An to Ruichuan An, adds a project-leader marker to Ming Zhong, and adds an equal-contribution marker to Liuzhou Zhang. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–29 and Tables 1–10 retain their content, design, captions, and placement. Page structure and appendix presentation remain unchanged; the first-page edits concern author and version text.

improvement.justification: v2 updates author credits and the version stamp while retaining the same scientific content, evidence, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility information throughout both the main text and appendices. These administrative edits leave the paper's overall scientific and expository quality materially unchanged.
